main_measure.name: next-day short-direction return minus the coin's mean daily return, over cases with forecast below 0

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases grouped by day

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean above 0 with day-grouped t >= 2 and check passes; reject: mean below 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: upper-half minus lower-half excess return, split at median close location

decided_by: The t lies between -2 and 2: inconclusive rule.
reading: The profile (60-bar fall and 365-bar volatility percentile, unrecorded and needing history before each window) is read from regime == mean_reversion, width is recomputed from prices where 30 past returns exist in the window (else taken as met by the regime), the t sums case deviations per UTC day, and the median split puts locations above the median in the upper half; fewer than 50 cases or days gives not observable.
